The Tolbooth Rooms open mic, Thursday 17 April 2025. Signup from 7:30, host is Callum Breen. Slot 6 of 14, 15 minutes max, he's strict, last time a guy got the light at 16 minutes and sulked.

## Set

1. "Clydebank Rain" (original), D, capo 2, 88 BPM, 3:40
2. "Pancho and Lefty" (Townes Van Zandt, 1972), G, 3:50
3. "Night Bus to Paisley" (original), 12/8, 72 BPM, 4:10
4. "Dirty Old Town" (Ewan MacColl), if time, 2:55

Total 14:35 with chat. Cut chat if running late, never cut "Dirty Old Town", the room sings it.

## Bring

- Lowden O-22, spare set of 12-53 strings, capo, two picks (I always lose one)
- Tuner pedal plus a 9 V battery, the Tolbooth has no power near the stage
- DI box, the house one crackles
- Lyric sheet for "Night Bus", second verse is new
- £5 for the bar tab deal, cash only

## After

- Played 1, 2, 3. Skipped "Dirty Old Town", over by 40 seconds already.
- "Night Bus to Paisley" got the best reaction. Keep the new verse.
- Callum offered a support slot on 22 May. Said yes.
